options.title: What's Really Inside an NVIDIA Graphics Chip?
options.first_line: What's really inside the NVIDIA chip that draws your games?
options.first_frame: A graphics card already turning on a dark stage, fans spinning, as the camera dives straight at its chip.

options.title: How Small Is One Switch Inside an NVIDIA Chip?
options.first_line: This NVIDIA chip is smaller than your palm. So how small is one switch inside it?
options.first_frame: The bare chip lifting out of the card beside a hand at true scale, the camera already pushing in on its surface.

options.title: An NVIDIA Chip Has 16,384 Cores. What's in One?
options.first_line: This NVIDIA chip has 16,384 little maths engines. What's inside just one?
options.first_frame: The chip's surface lit up as a glowing grid of cores, one of them flaring amber as the camera dives toward it.

why: A named chip next to a hand you can picture, plus a sharp 'how small?' question whose answer is held back, makes a stranger stop and stay, while A is a vague 'what's inside' and C leads with a big core count that is only big.
